stream_encoding: level-0 DEFLATE (stored blocks) in a real zlib (RFC 1950) wrapper; each stream carries distinct per-stream LCG content, so no plaintext is shared between streams

external_checks.qpdf_check: rc=0: 'No syntax or stream encoding errors found'

provenance.note: Generated twice; SHA-256 identical. The .pdf bytes are gitignored and regenerable from the command above.

corpus_limitation: Streams are level-0 (stored) zlib, so the corpus is the weak-producer regime where exact replay is trivially available and corrections are tiny (28 B/stream, deduplicated to one 28 B object). It is NOT a survey of strong real-world DEFLATE; it is a large multi-object random-access stress corpus. Distinctness of per-stream plaintext (not repeated-bytes) is what makes the query court meaningful.
